feed_summary: CISA has added CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to its KEV catalog after the Ivanti VPN flaws were chained in zero-day attacks. The post Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain
